signals.title: Hospital liquidity and capital funding are distinct buffers
signals.observation: HCAI lists a $10.6m Watsonville grant award in its 2026 program for hospitals meeting severe liquidity eligibility criteria as of April15. Its undated page does not verify September disbursement or current cash. The district separately states Measure N bond funds cannot pay personnel or service operating costs.
signals.confidence: High for published award and operator funding distinction; current liquidity unknown
signals.freshness: Newly discovered historical spring2026 stress and response; not newly observed September distress
signals.status: Dated stress/buffer example; current condition unknown
signals.implication: Track operating cash, staffed services and capital projects separately. A new scanner or restricted bond award cannot be counted as payroll reserve.

signals.title: Watsonville imaging replacement reaches licensing stage
signals.observation: District September8 release reports installation complete and state licensing approval September2 for replacement MRI/CT. Wording is inconsistent about start of clinical use; daily availability and transfer reduction remain unverified.
signals.confidence: High for operator-reported installation/licensing; medium for immediate availability
signals.implication: Healthy replacement could reduce travel and interfacility transfers while operating-finance vulnerability remains separate.

cascades.initiating_stress: Operating cash shortage persists beyond grant bridge
cascades.dependent_system: Healthcare access, workforce retention and essential transport
cascades.mechanism: If cash cannot cover staffed services, patients may need neighboring providers and longer trips; donor clinics and transport must have actual reserve. The branch is conditional, not a present closure claim.
cascades.buffers: Grant award; local public ownership and equipment replacement; confirmed recurring reimbursement and partnerships if available
cascades.thresholds: Dated board/operator evidence of reduced staffed service or payment-driven supply interruption
cascades.substitutes: Clinically appropriate outpatient/referral capacity and coordinated accessible transport subject to confirmed availability
cascades.time_horizon: Weeks to months for cash; months to years for durable operating model
cascades.uncertainty: Current cash balance, grant disbursement, staffing and partner surplus unverified
cascades.confirm: Current public financials plus documented service reduction and inability of nearby providers to absorb load
cascades.falsify: Sustained operating liquidity, retained staffed services and demonstrated shorter waits/less transfer demand
cascades.activation_status: Conditional watch; dated stress and improving hardware evidence coexist

buffers.name: Watsonville grant bridge and replacement imaging
buffers.type: Time-limited financial buffer plus separate capital replacement
buffers.readiness: Award announced; disbursement unknown. Imaging installed/licensed; routine clinical use unverified.
buffers.limits: No discretionary/exportable cash established; restricted capital cannot fund operations.
buffers.donor_guardrail: State award is a committed named allocation, not an uncommitted rescue fund; nearby providers must protect own staffed service floor.
buffers.essential_function: Maintain local clinical access and diagnostics

transitions.name: Replace unreliable imaging and protect local access
transitions.classification: Healthy replacement/growth candidate with implementation evidence
transitions.function_to_preserve: Timely local diagnostics and clinical workforce
transitions.released_assets: Potential avoided transfer trips and external imaging demand; no assumed surplus land, labor or saleable old equipment
transitions.safe_load_release: Avoid transfers solely for imaging once local service and clinical appropriateness are confirmed; no necessary care shedding
transitions.growth_candidate: Reliable local imaging, qualified maintenance and care navigation
transitions.conversion_requirements: Staffing, scheduling, maintenance, recurring operating funds, clinical availability verification
transitions.time_horizon: Near-term service verification after September licensing; ongoing operations
transitions.risks: Capital improvements do not close cash gap; partner consolidation could reduce local access if protections absent
transitions.status: Replacement installed/licensed; measured access benefit pending
transitions.success_observation: Published regular service plus shorter imaging waits and fewer avoidable transfers without added staffing stress

questions.question: Have grant funds arrived and replacement imaging entered regular patient service?
questions.next_public_action: Read next public PVHCD finance/board and operator service reports, separate operatingcash from restricted capital and check actual access evidence
